subject: ggplot does not work after upgrading from R 2.11.0 to R 2.11.1

messages.author: fe17e97d31cdeae6
messages.subject: ggplot does not work after upgrading from R 2.11.0 to R 2.11.1
parts:
I have been using ggplot2 successfully for a couple of years, but now
it does not work after I updated to R 2.11.1.

Here is a simple example:

> library(ggplot2)
Loading required package: reshape
Loading required package: plyr

Attaching package: 'plyr'

The following object(s) are masked from 'package:Hmisc':

is.discrete, summarize

Loading required package: grid
Loading required package: proto

> z <- data.frame(x=1:10, y=101:110)

> ggplot(data=z, aes(x=x, y=y)) + geom_point()
Error in get("make_aesthetics", env = x, inherits = TRUE)(x, ...) :
could not find function "empty"


I am running R on Windows XP Professional, Version 2002, Service Pack
3, using Tinn-R. The version of ggplot2 I am using is 0.8.8. (I
updated to the lastest version after installing R 2.11.1. I also
uninstalled and reinstalled ggplot2, and it still did not work.)

More information from sessionInfo():

States.1252 LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252
